address: Rua de Santa Maria, Largo da Oliveira, Guimaraes, 4800-443, Portugal
bio: Visiting Guimarães is like diving into Portugal’s history, a city revered for its historical importance in the country and acknowledged as “the birthplace of the Portuguese nation”. Located in the Hotel da Oliveira, right next to the impressive Church of Nossa Senhora da Oliveira, this venue boasts a classic décor, highlighted by stone walls and ceilings adorned with wooden beams. The culinary offering, designed by Chef Vítor Matos and overseen daily by Chef Liliana Moura, showcases a modern and creative cuisine with Mediterranean touches, taking traditional roots as its reference point. The menu, which includes some vegetarian dishes, is rounded out by two tasting menus (Raízes [“Roots”] and À Descoberta [“Discovery”])....
